# synology_time_machine (Resource)

Bonjour Time Machine advertisement and backup-share selection. Share data, quotas and backup execution are managed separately. Import adopts current policy; destroy never removes shares or backups.

## Adopt existing settings

Use an initialized project from [Check the NAS connection](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/elephant-evergreen/synology/latest/docs#check-the-nas-connection). Add this import block with your resource address and the ID of the existing DSM object.

```terraform
import {
  to = synology_time_machine.nas
  id = "time_machine"
}
```

1. Add the resource block with the values DSM currently reports. Use the sample configuration as a starting point.
2. Run `terraform plan -out=adopt.tfplan`. For one import, expect `1 to import, 0 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy`. If the plan proposes changes, match the differing arguments to DSM and save a new plan.
3. Run `terraform apply adopt.tfplan` once the saved plan contains only the import. The next `terraform plan` should report `No changes`.

## Example configuration

```terraform
resource "synology_time_machine" "nas" {
  smb_enabled = true
  afp_enabled = false
  shares      = ["backups"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `afp_enabled` (Boolean) Advertise Time Machine over AFP.
- `shares` (Set of String) Complete set of existing shared-folder names advertised for Time Machine.
- `smb_enabled` (Boolean) Advertise Time Machine over SMB. Keep the SMB service enabled.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Singleton identity and import identifier: time_machine. Destroy only releases Terraform management; it never resets DSM settings.
